items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: he could tell you the average of Ty Cobb or anybody years before

ctx.x: Art was really a sweetheart. He was a nice man, except he didn’t want to talk music, he wanted to talk baseball. You know he could tell you the average of Ty Cobb or anybody years before, you know? And how much they batted and what they did and all that. He was a good pinochle player too.
Interesting. You have accompanied along the way some great singers, too.
